correctness.rationale: Accept Ostrovski’s published polygon existence, rotation number, and foliation for his special parameter family, not any generic angle. Quarter-orbit closure after K corner steps and N bottom shears gives r_N(1+N delta)=1. Because det B=1, each corner or shear increment has raw determinant -t delta r_N^2. The fourfold shoelace identity, including its center-translation telescope, yields enclosed polygon area 1-4t r_N+2t(1-K delta)r_N^2, hence outer area 4t r_N-2t(1-K delta)r_N^2. At N=0 this equals 2t(1+K delta). Published continuous monotone foliation identifies the exact exterior-polygon area with the slow-rotation sublevel distribution at rho_N=1/[4(K+N)]. Since neighboring thresholds differ by O(N^-2), monotone sandwiching upgrades the discrete expansion to all eps: area=(16t/delta)eps+O_K(eps^2); normalize by the annulus area to obtain the reciprocal-rotation 1/R tail and divergent expectation. The reciprocal rotation number is not mistakenly interpreted as an orbital return period.
verification: Independent symbolic corner-to-shear closure and shoelace identity checked at K=3 and N=0,1 with exact theta=pi/8: exterior areas approximately 0.55025253169417 and 0.43182407278437, matching formula. Analytical determinant argument supplies unrestricted K,N.
